text:
raj: heads up — started seeing app-of-apps failing to fully reconcile in eu-central after the monorepo merge. flux/webhook spikes + submodule fetch errors.
emma: saw prune waves delete a few gpu-reservation CRs around the same time. that looks like the immediate capacity hit.
chris: confirming: flux logs show repeated 502/504 from github while fetching repo and then `git ls-tree` on submodule path failed (404). caused partial manifests to be applied.
jen: infra-bot alerted: Dedicated GPU pool (eu-central-1) capacity dropped from ~96% -> 62% within 3m. fallback started launching on-demand nodes.
infra-bot: Alert at 21:02 UTC — eu-central gpu-pool: available=31 desired=50 status=degraded; reason=fallback-on-demand-trigger
raj: most suspicious bit — during the monorepo move someone replaced the charts submodule with a submodule reference path that CI didn't populate in the mirrored repo. flux fetched a repo tree missing helm charts which made app-of-apps prune the charts namespace resources.
chris: quick repro commands I ran:
```
flux check --status
kubectl -n gitops get apps.app.k8s.io -o wide
kubectl get gpureservations -A | grep Pruned
```
saw `gpu-reservation-1234   pruned` in the list.
ryan-oncall: cost note — fallback to on-demand GPUs increased eu billing +38% last hour. Need to contain.
jen: digging into terraform history: there was a concurrent terraform apply that renamed a namespace annotation used by our app selector `gitops.redwood/team` -> `gitops.team`. That caused the app-of-apps parent to think child apps had moved and prune them.
raj: remediation steps proposed:
- pin app-of-apps to previous commit (sha: a1b2c3d)
- disable automated prune for that appset temporarily
- force flux/argocd reconcile once repo is pinned
- revert terraform rename or add compatibility alias on selector
- add a short debounce after repo pushes to avoid webhook storms triggering concurrent reconciles
chris: doing manual reconcile now: `argocd app sync app-of-apps --prune=false` then `kubectl apply -f gpu-reservation-manifests.yaml` to recreate critical CRs.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: revert commit a1b2c3d -> will run pipeline in ~2m
emma: after sync + manual apply, gpu reservations reappeared and pool is back to 94% available. still monitoring for stray prunes.
raj: adding follow-ups: (1) make repo mirror include submodules properly in CI, (2) add healthcheck to prevent prune of CRs with active reservations, (3) add alerting for rapid prune + capacity drop correlation.
jen: I'll open the billing ticket and tag finance for chargeback. also adding a postmortem doc to /docs/incidents.
ryan-oncall: iterator: +1 on debounce; also let's add `--no-prune` canary window for app-of-apps on big merges for 30m.
emma: tl;dr: monorepo+missing submodule + terraform annotation rename + webhook burst = partial reconcile -> prune of gpu reservations -> fallback on-demand -> cost spike. fixed by pin+manual reconcile+recreate CRs. postmortem incoming. :white_check_mark:
raj: thanks all — leaving the pin in place until CI mirrors submodules correctly and terraform is reverted. will update thread when PRs are green.
jen: :thumbsup:
